allow_instructions: Allow just sm-* from the repo root: sm-add, sm-claim, sm-next, sm-finish, sm-accept, sm-gate, sm-status, sm-defaults, sm-scope, sm-auto, sm-handoff, sm-watch, sm-tail, sm-init, sm-configure.
Allow uv run dm-software-machine/scripts/dmsm.py and any subcommand of that CLI.
Allow npm and cargo inside the app folder (install, build, test, fmt, check, clippy, tauri). Network to crates.io, npmjs.org, and GitHub is expected for those tools.
Allow git status, git diff, git log, and git add limited to task writes. Allow git commit only with a message the machine or engineer already stated.
Allow python3 and uv for dm-software-machine scripts. Allow just recipes in this justfile.
block_instructions: Ask before git push, force-push, git config, or rewriting history.
Ask before brew install, npm install -g, or writing outside this workspace (including the Cursor Agent Store and home directory).
Ask before deleting files outside the task writes paths.
